docs.title: Welcome to Our Organization
docs.text: Welcome! We are excited to have you join us. This centralized hub contains all the foundational guides, tooling setups, and workflow standards you need to get up to speed, regardless of which project repository you are working on.

docs.title: Where to Next?
docs.text:
• Prerequisites: Check off the accounts, permissions, and system access required on day one.
  • Tooling Setup: Install and configure your local development environment.
  • Git Standards: Learn how we manage branches, pull requests, and code reviews across our repositories.

Need Help? If you run into blockers during your setup, reach out in our team communication channels or open an issue in this repository.

docs.title: Prerequisites & Access
docs.text: Before you can start contributing to our repositories, you need to set up your core accounts and request the necessary permissions.

docs.title: 1. GitHub Organization Access
docs.text:
• Account: Ensure you have a personal GitHub account with two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled (mandatory for all organization members).
  • Invitation: Accept the organization invitation sent to your email.
  • Teams: Ask your project lead to assign you to the appropriate team repository groups.

docs.title: 2. Communication & Collaboration Tools
docs.text:
• Join our primary communication channels.
  • Ensure your profile includes your real name and a professional avatar so team members can easily identify you.
